THIS MFA CROB FILED U/O 41 RULE 22 OF THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE R/W SECTION 173(1), JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 15-07-2010 PASSED IN MVC NO. 1228/2006 ON THE FILE OF ADDL. MACT II, I FAST TRACK COURT, SHIMOGA,
PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
THIS APPEAL, AND MFA CROB COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE HANCHATE SANJEEVKUMAR  ORAL JUDGMENT MFA No.4220/2015 is filed by the owner of the Mahendra Pickup Van questioning the liability fastened on it.
MFA Crob No.111/2015 is filed by the claimants seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the learned counsel for both the parties in both the above matters and perused the material on record.
3.

Brief facts of the case are :
That the case of the claimants is that on 03.04.2002 the deceased Srinivasa Bovi was traveling in NC: 2024:KHC:45858 Mahendra Pickup Van bearing No.MH-06-G-3811 by sitting on back side of the vehicle, towards the School at Yelavatti to attend examination and the said vehicle was being driven with high speed and while negotiating a curve, the said Srinivasa Bovi fell down from the vehicle and sustained bleeding injuries on the vital parts of the body and blood was oozing out from Nose and Ears and on the way to Hospital, he succumbed to the injuries.
Therefore, the appellants/parents of deceased Srinivasa Bovi have filed claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, claiming compensation.

The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.1,85,000/- with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition and till the date of payment and fastened liability on the appellant/ owner of the Mahindra Pickup Van on the reason that Insurance Policy was Act policy/liability only policy and the deceased has traveled in the vehicle as a gratuitous passenger,
thus exonerated the Insurance Company and saddled liability on the appellant/owner of the Mahindra Pickup Van.

NC: 2024:KHC:45858 M/S N R Construction Company vs Dodda Durga Bhovi on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17365942/
4 4.

entities.text: 2024:KHC:45858 M/S N R Construction Company vs Dodda Durga Bhovi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the present case, the deceased was 15 years old boy.

Ex.P2 is the FIR, which proves that the deceased was traveling in the Mahindra Pickup Van and he fell down from the Van, while the driver was negotiating a curve and at that time, the vehicle was being driven with high speed, and in rash and negligent manner, due to which the deceased fell on the road and sustained injuries to the head and then on the way to the Hospital he died.
Therefore, it is proved that the deceased was gratuitous passenger traveling in the Mahindra Pickup Van bearing No.MH-06-G-3811.
Ex.P1 is the Police Notice, Ex.P3 is the Spot Panchanama and Ex.P4 is the Post Mortem Report

, all these documents prove that the deceased died in the motor vehicle accident and this is rightly considered by the Tribunal.
5. Ex.R1 is the Insurance Policy, which is Act policy/ which is liability only policy.
The deceased was traveling in the said Mahindra Pickup Van and he is not a third NC: 2024:KHC:45858 party.

Upon considering Ex.R1/Insurance Policy, which is liability only policy, it is seen that premium is paid towards third party as legal liability to spare drivers, for three employees other than spare drivers,
for incurring third party property damage risk and for use of commercial purpose.
For these categories only premium is paid.
Here the deceased was not an employee, but was student and going for writing examination in the said Mahindra Pickup Van.
Therefore, it is proved that the deceased was traveling gratuitously in the Mahindra Pickup Van.
There is no premium paid covering the risk of passengers in the vehicle.
Ex.R.1 is the liability only policy, therefore, the risk of passengers traveling in the Mahindra Pickup Van is not covered.
Therefore, in this regard, the Tribunal is correct in fastening the liability on the owner of Mahindra Pick-up Van by exonerating the Insurance Company.

This Court in the case of DIVISIONAL MANAGER, UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED AND OTHERS NC: 2024:KHC:45858 Vs. SHAMARAYA AND OTHERS1 held that where the Insurance Policy is liability only policy, risk of gratuitous passengers in the vehicle are not covered unless extra premium is paid.

entities.text: DIVISIONAL MANAGER, UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED AND OTHERS NC: 2024:KHC:45858 Vs. SHAMARAYA AND OTHERS1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: But Ex.R1 proves that no such extra premium is paid except the persons as stated above.
Therefore, the Tribunal is correct in fastening liability on the appellant/owner of the Mahindra Pickup Van.
6. The Tribunal has awarded compensation of Rs.1,85,000/- with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of payment.
The compensation awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
The deceased was 15 years old boy and was a student.

In this regard, this Court in LAXMINARAYANAPPA @ MOOGAPPA AND OTHERS Vs. ROYAL SUNDARAM ALLIANZ INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED AND ANOTHER2 has elaborately considered the aspect in case of death of minor children, as to what would be the MFA No.31781/2010 and Connected matters Dt:
22.12.2020 MFA No.11440/2011 Connected with MFA No.206/2018 Dt:12.09.2024 NC:
2024:KHC:45858 quantum of compensation to be awarded.

entities.text: LAXMINARAYANAPPA @ MOOGAPPA AND OTHERS Vs. ROYAL SUNDARAM ALLIANZ INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED AND ANOTHER2
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the said case this Court, after adopting the methodology by taking into consideration Second Schedule of the Motor Vehicles Act determined the compensation to be awarded in case of death of gratuitous passengers in train accidents by taking the average of these two has formulated the compensation according to the year of accident.

Accordingly, in the year 2002 in which year the accident occurred, the minors of age 15 to 18 the compensation to be awarded come to Rs.5,83,872/-.
7.

Therefore, in the instant case, the deceased being aged 15 years, the claimants/parents would be entitled to compensation of Rs.5,83,872/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of M/S N R Construction Company vs Dodda Durga Bhovi on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17365942/
5 petition till the date of payment.

entities.text: M/S N R Construction Company vs Dodda Durga Bhovi
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. Hence I proceed to pass the following :-
ORDER a. MFA No.4220/2015 is dismissed.
b. MFA Crob No.111/2015 is allowed in part.
The judgment and award dated 15.07.2010 passed in MVC No.1228/2006 by the District Judge, Additional MACT-II, I Fast Track Court at Shimoga, is modified.

entities.text: District Judge, Additional MACT-II, I Fast Track Court at Shimoga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
d. The claimants in MFA Crob No.111/2015 are entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.3,98,872/-(Rs.5,83,872/- less Rs.1,85,000/-) along with interest at the rate of 6%
p.a. from the date of petition till the date of payment, in addition to compensation awarded by the Tribunal.
e. The 3rd respondent/owner of the Mahindra Pickup Van bearing No.MH-06-G-3811 is liable to pay compensation to the claimants.
f. The enhanced compensation shall not carry interest for the delayed period of 71 days.
g. Registry is directed to transmit the Trial Court Records to the concerned Tribunal forthwith.
Draw the award accordingly.
i. No order as to costs.

SD/-
